description-proc.fra: Afin de renforcer son expertise interne, Enabel s’entoure d’un nombre important d’expert·es et de consultant·es externes. Le présent marché concerne le domaine de la gouvernance, la paix et la sécurité et comprend 6 lots : - Lot 1 : Paix et Sécurité : réforme du secteur de la sécurité (RSS) - Lot 2 : Justice et État de droit - Lot 3 : Fragilité, prévention et gestion des conflits - Lot 4 : État civil - Lot 5 : Gouvernance démocratique - Lot 6 : Gouvernance économique Le présent marché est passé selon la modalité de l’accord-cadre avec plusieurs participants au sens de l’article 43 de la loi du 17 juin 2016. L’accord-cadre établit les termes régissant les marchés à passer au cours de la période de validité de l’accord. L’accord-cadre (chaque lot) sera conclu avec plusieurs participants après une mise en concurrence réalisée via une procédure ouverte sur la base du rapport qualité/prix. Pour chaque marché à passer, conformément à l’article 43, § 5, 3° de la loi, l’exécution de l’accord-cadre se fera selon les modalités définies au point 3.4.9. Pour ce marché, un accord-cadre (chaque lot) sera conclu avec les trois soumissionnaires sélectionnés qui ont déposé une offre régulière et qui, lors de l’examen des offres dans le cadre du critère d’attribution, ont obtenu les trois cotations finales les plus élevées.
description-proc.nld: Om zijn interne expertise te versterken, doet Enabel een beroep op een groot aantal externe experts en consultants. Deze opdracht heeft betrekking op het domein van bestuur, vrede en veiligheid en bestaat uit 6 percelen: - Perceel 1: Vrede en veiligheid: hervorming van de veiligheidssector (SSR - Security Sector Reform) - Perceel 2: Justitie en Rechtsstaat - Perceel 3: Onstabiliteit, conflictpreventie en -beheersing - Perceel 4: Burgerlijke stand - Perceel 5: Democratisch bestuur - Perceel 6: Economisch bestuur Deze overheidsopdracht wordt afgesloten volgens de modaliteit van de raamovereenkomst met meerdere deelnemers in de zin van artikel 43 van de wet van 17 juni 2016. De raamovereenkomst legt de voorwaarden vast van de opdrachten die gegund worden gedurende de geldigheidsperiode van de overeenkomst. De raamovereenkomst (elk perceel) wordt afgesloten met meerdere deelnemers na een beroep op mededinging via een open procedure op basis van de prijs-kwaliteitverhouding. Voor elke opdracht die wordt gegund, wordt de raamovereenkomst uitgevoerd volgens de procedures bepaald in punt 3.4.9, overeenkomstig artikel 43, § 5, 3° van de wet. Voor deze opdracht wordt een raamovereenkomst gesloten (elk perceel) met de drie geselecteerde inschrijvers die een regelmatige offerte hebben ingediend en die bij de offerteanalyse in het kader van de gunningscriteria de drie hoogste eindscores hebben behaald.
description-proc.eng: To strengthen its in-house expertise, Enabel calls on a large number of external experts and consultants. The framework agreement establishes the terms governing public contracts to be concluded during the validity period of the agreement. The framework agreement (each lot) will be concluded with several participants following competition via an open procedure on the basis of the best value for money. For each public contract to be awarded, in accordance with Article 43, §5, 3° of the Law, the performance of the framework agreement will follow the modalities defined in point 3.4.9. For this public contract, a framework agreement (each lot) will be concluded with the three tenderers selected having submitted a regular tender and having obtained upon examination of the tenders against the award criterion the three highest final scores.

title-proc.eng: 81322848 - Development of sustainable financial instruments in Senegal

description-proc.eng: The project "Strengthening sustainable finance in Senegal" (02/25-01/28), mandated by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) aims to strengthen sustainable financing in the financial sector in Senegal. It advises and develops the skills of political decision-makers as well as financial sector actors. A main activity is supporting the development and implementation of the Senegalese green finance taxonomy. The project also includes advisory services to financial institutions to develop and apply innovative sustainable financing instruments. In this way, the project contributes to improving the conditions for a green and socially just financial market in Senegal. On a macro level, the project cooperates closely with the the Ministry of Finance and Budget (MFB), Ministry of Environment and Ecological Transition (METE), Ministry of Economy and Planning (MEPC) and the Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO). The downstream project structures also include the public development banks, primarily the National Development Bank (BNDE), the Agricultural Bank (LBA), a state-owned investment fund (FONSIS) as well as commercial banks and to a lesser extend microfinance institutions. The topics of cooperation include scaling sustainable financing through innovative financial instruments, sustainable business models and pipeline building, and risk management strategies. The project intervenes primarily at macro and meso level. It supports senior officials from the all relevant ministries and regulatory and supervisory entities who aim to enhance their policy-making and financial oversight skills regarding sustainable financing. Additionally, senior staff from financial institutions and private sector companies are also targeted. The project encompasses two primary outputs. Output 1 focuses on policy advice. It involves providing advice and capacity building to the Ministry of Finance and other stakeholders within the financial sector on developing a gender-sensitive national strategy and ensuring policy coherence for sustainable finance, including advice on gender mainstreaming. Moreover, it includes advising on the development and implementation of a green taxonomy. Output 2 addresses financial instruments and tools for sustainable financing. This involves consulting with financial sector stakeholders to develop innovative sustainable financing instruments, products, and models, such as green bonds. At the transition to 2025, the municipality sharpened these arrangements so that building and construction projects under the auspices of the municipality ́s entities as a main rule shall be implemented with; 1) emission free systems at the building or construction site, 2) emission free or biogas based mass transport and; 3) emission free or fossil free vehicles for other transport (depending on the allowed total weight). The requirements are in the accompanying annex to this notice. The aim of this survey is to update the Agency for Urban Environment ́s knowledge around the market's maturity in order to use the main rules here presented in the Urban Environment Agency's typical project portfolio. The Agency for Urban Environment has experience for various reasons that not all systems for emission-free execution are completely ripe for a zero emission requirement. Reasons can be, among other things, low capacity for necessary machines and equipment in emission-free varieties, uncertain or immature technology for certain assignments in regard to quality and execution, special equipment and machines that are not commercially available or do not exist whatsoever, or other considerations in projects that mean that it is not practically possible to make requirements on or use emission free systems. With regard to transporting matter, the Agency for Urban Environment has learned that most of the mass transport to and from plants is carried out with biogas technology. We would like to introduce some incentives in the municipality ́s contracts for building and construction projects so that a more balanced mix is achieved from biogas based and emission-free mass transport. The Agency for Urban Environment would like feedback from several parts of the supplier chain in connection with building and construction assets - from the executing/main contractor to technical disciplines and sub-contractors, building materials and mass transport, landlords and sellers of site machines and construction equipment etc. The information is very important so that the Agency for Urban Environment can set suitable requirements in coming competitions that take into account predictability, equal competition terms and in the long term be able to meet expectations of contractors who have taken measures to meet the municipality ́s ambitions for 100% emission free building and construction sites.

title-proc.eng: Study assignment Rond Ronse

description-proc.fra: La présente mission concerne le projet « Rond Ronse ». Des informations complémentaires sur ce projet sont disponibles sur www.rondronse.be. Pour ce projet, un processus de planification intégré a déjà été mené, aboutissant à l’adoption définitive du GRUP « Rond Ronse ». Les documents y afférents peuvent être consultés sur le site suivant : https://www.vlaanderen.be/vlaamse-regering/beslissingen-van-de-vlaamse-regering/definitieve-vaststelling-gewestelijk-ruimtelijk-uitvoeringsplan-grup-rond-ronse#documenten. La décision du Gouvernement flamand relative à l’adoption définitive du GRUP est jointe en annexe 3. Le dossier complet de planification, y compris toutes les annexes, peut être consulté via DSI – Detail – Rond Ronse. Le GRUP Rond Ronse a été annulé à la suite d’un arrêt du Conseil d’État du 3 novembre 2025 (n° 264.738). Cette mission d’étude porte sur des prestations liées à la reprise du processus de planification, ainsi que sur l’assistance dans la procédure d’obtention d’un ou plusieurs permis d’environnement, la procédure de passation (en principe via le dialogue compétitif) et l’exécution du marché ou des marchés pour la réalisation du projet. Les prestations peuvent également concerner la mise en œuvre de travaux anticipés ou de projets « quick win » (y compris des prestations pour l’autoroute cyclable Oudenaarde–Ronse). En outre, le Pouvoir adjudicateur pourra également faire appel à l’Entrepreneur pour diverses prestations liées à l’objet de la présente mission. L’Entrepreneur devra collaborer avec un ou plusieurs collaborateurs désignés par le Pouvoir adjudicateur issus d’une agence de communication et des gestionnaires de parties prenantes.
description-proc.nld: Voorliggende Opdracht heeft betrekking op het project “Rond Ronse”. Nadere gegevens omtrent dit project kan worden gevonden op www.rondronse.be. De documenten dienaangaande zijn terug te vinden op volgende website: https://www.vlaanderen.be/vlaamse-regering/beslissingen-van-de-vlaamse-regering/definitieve-vaststelling-gewestelijk-ruimtelijk-uitvoeringsplan-grup-rond-ronse#documenten. Deze studieopdracht heeft betrekking op prestaties in het kader van de herneming van het planningsproces, alsook op bijstand in het kader van procedure voor het verkrijgen van één of meer omgevingsvergunningen, van de plaatsingsprocedure (in principe via de concurrentiegerichte dialoog) en bij de uitvoering van de opdracht of opdrachten tot realisatie van het project. De prestaties kunnen ook betrekking hebben op de realisatie van vooruitgeschoven werken of quick win-projecten (incl. prestaties t.b.v. de fietssnelweg Oudenaarde-Ronse). title-proc.eng: Multi-Party Framework of Demolition Contractors for Dublin City Council

description-proc.eng: It is proposed to establish a Multi-Party Framework of Demolition Contractors for Dublin City Council. It is anticipated that the works will consist of: - Demolitions (incl. former residential properties, old housing stock, derelict buildings and other buildings / structures etc.). - Enabling works (incl. site clearance / preparation, earthworks, removal / diversion of existing services, installation of new services etc.). - Removal and disposal of waste materials and hazardous materials (e.g. soils, asbestos, lead based paint, guano etc.). - General site works (e.g. fencing, drainage etc.). - Minor building, civil and landscaping works. In some instances, the works may include the following: - Weathering of adjoining buildings. - Design, manufacture and installation of temporary works (incl. façade retention). - Hazardous materials surveys. The Framework may also be used for certain enabling works associated with development of sites, including demolitions and service diversions. The Framework Agreement will apply to individual projects with anticipated values ranging up to €3,000,000. The majority of projects are envisaged to be less than €1,000,000 in value. Applications are only invited from contractors who have a proven track record in demolition and ancillary works as described above. Applications are not invited from general building contractors who propose to sub-contract the whole of the works. As the demolition works are expected to include removal of hazardous materials and certain temporary works (incl. façade retention), the demolition contractors shall be in a position to provide these services, using suitably competent and experienced sub-contractors or consultants as necessary. There will be no separate assessment of specialists at this time. The Framework will be established thus: After Stage 1 (Expressions of Interest), up to twelve (12) Applicants will be shortlisted for admission to Stage 2. Stage 2 of the competition will comprise an Invitation to Tender to the shortlisted Applicants for an initial competition for a typical demolition project. The competition will include assessment of price and quality. The highest ranked tenderer in the Stage 2 competition will be awarded the initial contract. A minimum of three (3) and maximum of eight (8) Applicants (including the highest scoring tenderer for the initial contract) will be invited to enter into a Framework Agreement (PW-CF9) with Dublin City Council from which future demolition contracts will be procured. All future competitions procured using this Framework will be awarded by mini-competition. It is anticipated that demolition works will be carried out under PWC-5 Minor Works Contract. However, Dublin City Council reserves the right to use other forms of contracts (CWMF) should it deem it appropriate. The maximum estimated value of the works over the lifetime of the framework (48 months) will be €9,500,000 (ex VAT). Please note that this project is subject to funding. For further information please refer to documentation available to download from www.etenders.gov.ie Resource ID 7263959
